_readme: Per-module pins for tools/build-mindmap.py. Keys are module folder names
(case-insensitive; hyphens/spaces interchangeable), plus two special keys:
aliases - CLI short names mapped to a folder, e.g. `cn` -> `Complex Numbers`
Labels are pinned only where the golden modules' mind maps carry hand-tuned
titles that differ from the chapter <h1>. New modules normally need no entry:
labels auto-derive from each chapter's <h1>. Optional pins: title, brand, name.
